experiment: E6 dynamic state-aware topology under strict LOPO
state_convention: post-current: operation t is applied before ranking future candidates with t+1 as reference positive
dynamic_update: executed fixation removes its fixation edge; executed part marks its node removal-complete; the node is deactivated only after no unexecuted modeled fixation remains incident
notes: Dynamic shuffled graphs transform both the initial topology and every later structural event through the same fixed node permutation, preserving the unlabeled dynamic graph sequence while breaking semantic-topological alignment. Operation-local categorical and original true-degree features are identical across all conditions.
